description:
Adds the rate-matched 5G NR implementer of the batch soft-decoder trait, which prepares each frame onto the mother code and decodes the batch through the LDPC batch decoder.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. `Nr5gRateMatchedDecoder` wraps a single-frame decoder of the mother code: it prepares a rate-matched LLR frame into mother-code LLRs, with the zero LLR at punctured and truncated positions and the filler magnitude at filler positions, decodes, and extracts the message bits in natural column order [ThreeGpp2017]. To the decoder the prepared LLRs are ordinary channel LLRs. Through the trait's default path it decodes one frame per call.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A rate-matched batch decoder implements the batch soft-decoder trait over the LDPC batch decoder, with the message bits of each frame as decoded words and the LDPC decoder's preferred granularity.
- [hard] REQ-02: It passes the shared batch contract function against `Nr5gRateMatchedDecoder::decode_iterative`, for configurations with punctured systematic columns, truncated parity and filler bits.
- [hard] REQ-03: Preparation reuses decoder-owned buffers: a steady-state batch decode into prepared outputs performs no allocation.
- [hard] REQ-04: The external 5G NR conformance vectors of the crate decode to their expected messages through the batch decoder.

## Notes

Source references: [ThreeGpp2017].
title: Decode rate-matched 5G NR frame batches in lanes
